title: numma gorrisah yan mari
intro: ucsub waktiy imaan gexkalit luk suge, kee butta rooci doorteh aggiriqqe sinni kibal baad raacat. meysi dooritih foocal, oson dabboh gorrisan, qaadik yan xin fan beyah yan safar qemmisen. Ken aydaadi qibaadah kalaluu ​​kee zulmi sadih imaan caylah sumaaqa. Atu too assakat le cankâ marih kinnaane baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu qunxa koboxuk sugne, inki gineenal kaxxa imaanat inkittiino luk sugne.
Nanu elle nannom caylale moyti Yallak kalah qibaadah essera wakti kinni.
ninni diini dacrisnuh, nanu ninni buxaaxi cabba hayneh zulmih kudak nirgiqeh.
Aamanti le waklenta, ardi gineenit, ni safaral nee luk suge.
Nanu qilsi aracal geyne, Yalli adda xer xin nee culse.
nanu ugten wak, nanu naaminem dubuk ayro hinnay ayrok exxa taturtem, takkay immay bool karmoomi nummaak taturte.
arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
